build_hidden_agenda_substrate: build the hidden_agenda substrate given player roles and a config dict
create_player_prefab: create a player prefab for a crewmate or impostor with specified role and pseudorewards
create_prefabs_dictionary: create a prefabs dictionary with all game objects for the hidden_agenda environment
get_hidden_agenda_config: get the default config for the hidden_agenda level with pseudorewards and observation specs
create_action_set: create the action set for agents with movement, tagging, and voting actions
